_about: Changes applied to the source for the public build only (build.py public). Each 'from' must appear exactly once in the source after the personal blocks are stripped. Then the mod is renamed: every 'Passive Picker' becomes '<name>', every 'PassivePicker' (files, global) becomes '<name without spaces>', and the addon path becomes mods/<author>/<addon>.
author: vibeslacker

replace.to: -- Passive Picker 1.2.0, for Bingus Shared Loader v15+.
